title: Coordinator state for the next session
role: Coordinator: plans, writes prompts for other sessions, reviews their PRs, merges. Does not write feature code itself.
owner_rules: Owner writes Russian, takes part minimally (AGENTS.md 'Owner And Questions'); design questions go to another session or model.
Always tell the owner about open questions: one line each, settled how, or a yes/no question with a recommendation; explain a product question in plain words (what readers see), not in code terms.
Coordinator may merge docs and test PRs itself after review and green CI.
Code-behavior PRs: merge only with the owner's yes.
Tags v0.1.NNN trigger deploy: only on the owner's request. Do not watch the deploy unless asked.
Prod (ssh ai-news) is read-only; any write needs the owner's yes.
Work in git worktrees from origin/master; no git writes in the main folder. venv1 is editable on the main folder: in a worktree run checks with PYTHONPATH=src ../AI_PARSER/venv1/bin/...
Docs-only PRs skip the full gate (say so in the PR). Merge with gh pr merge --merge.
Independent tasks may run in parallel sessions; give the owner the exact launch line for each.
